Update23 July 2025·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
Patch 1.3.5j Highlights
Patch 1.3.5j Highlights Progression & Utility - The is now rewarded from the instead of a quest (fixes delivery issues) - is now craftable at the - allows you to craft +150/-150 stat migrations item for a low honor cost. It makes migrating to/from another stat a lot easier & cheaper in the long run. Housing & Taxation…

Patch 1.3.5j Highlights

Progression & Utility

  • The Catch-Up Kit is now rewarded from the Level 50 Achievement instead of a quest (fixes delivery issues)
  • Migration Stone is now craftable at the Proven Warrior Workbench
    • Migration Stone allows you to craft +150/-150 stat migrations item for a low honor cost. It makes migrating to/from another stat a lot easier & cheaper in the long run.

Housing & Taxation

  • Beanstalk Houses are no longer Heavy-Tax Exempt

-Fixed a bug where players with New Player Housing could still receive tax mails despite owning houses elsewhere If you own New Player Housing & got extra land, your NPH land will demolish naturally from unpaid taxes

Arena & PvP Fixes

  • URF Arena: All crowd control durations have been reduced by 50%
  • Arena Rankings now reset properly on SUNDAYS (At midnight, in the night between Sunday and Monday)

Equipment & Crafting Changes

  • Vivid Earth Lunascale: Mastery can now be extracted from socketed gear Not retroactive to existing gems
  • Erenor Cloaks can now be reverted and reselected using an Ipnysh Cloakmuter Grade and stats are lost
  • Kingdom's Heart required for Monarch of the Sea craft reduced from 10 → 5
  • Transmutated T6 gear can now be transmutated again (previously limited to once)

Visuals & Animations

  • Fixed driver animations for Marketplace vehicles – characters now sit properly when driving

== Patch 1.3.5j Highlights ==

== Progression & Utility ==
* The '''Catch-Up Kit''' is now rewarded from the '''Level 50 Achievement''' instead of a quest (fixes delivery issues)
* '''Migration Stone''' is now craftable at the '''Proven Warrior Workbench'''
** '''Migration Stone''' allows you to craft +150/-150 stat migrations item for a low honor cost. It makes migrating to/from another stat a lot easier & cheaper in the long run.

== Housing & Taxation ==
* '''Beanstalk Houses''' are '''no longer Heavy-Tax Exempt'''
-Fixed a bug where players with '''New Player Housing''' could still receive '''tax mails''' despite owning houses elsewhere
''If you own New Player Housing & got extra land, your NPH land will demolish naturally from unpaid taxes''

== Arena & PvP Fixes ==
* '''URF Arena''': All '''crowd control durations''' have been reduced by '''50%'''
* '''Arena Rankings''' now reset '''properly''' on '''SUNDAYS''' (At midnight, in the night between Sunday and Monday)

== Equipment & Crafting Changes ==
* '''Vivid Earth Lunascale: Mastery''' can now be '''extracted''' from socketed gear ''Not retroactive to existing gems''
* '''Erenor Cloaks''' can now be reverted and reselected using an '''Ipnysh Cloakmuter''' ''Grade and stats are lost''
* '''Kingdom's Heart''' required for '''Monarch of the Sea''' craft reduced from '''10 → 5'''
* '''Transmutated T6 gear''' can now be '''transmutated again''' (previously limited to once)

== Visuals & Animations ==
* Fixed '''driver animations''' for '''Marketplace vehicles''' – characters now sit properly when driving
